question: is Paley(23) arc-critical for 5-inducibility (majority)?
note: A witness for Paley(23) with one arc reversed, restricted to an endpoint of that arc, is a witness for Paley(23)-v.  So arc-criticality holds iff SOME Paley(23)-v witness extends by re-inserting the deleted vertex with exactly one arc at it flipped.  The reduction is COMPLETE but not cheaper: most base states hold zero witnesses and proving that is the refutation work.
refutation_price_basis: 113 s per base state x 8031, measured; lower bound (early completions are biased cheap)
